sloka: ततः प्रविविशुः शेष राजानो लोकसम्मताः ।अथ राजवितीर्णेषु विविधेष्वासनेषु च ॥२-१-४९॥
transliteration: tataḥ praviviśuḥ śeṣa rājāno lokasammatāḥ ।atha rājavitīrṇeṣu vividheṣvāsaneṣu ca ॥2-1-49॥

translations.english: Then the kings (who entered the assembly) took the seats assigned to them facing the king (Dasaratha), following the royal tradition.
